case.summary: Case HHG-011 was opened on 2016-12-29 following a customer report from customer C11923 disputing online transaction 3583368 for $131.30 on card C11923-K2. Graph analysis and the closed-case classifier evaluated the incident under the card_not_present_new_device pattern, assigning a fraud probability of 0.86 across 2 affected transactions totaling $230.00. Because the investigation revealed multiple independent fraud signals and shared device origins with connected cards C03938-K1 and C05595-K1, the final actions include blocking the card, creating a case, filing a report, and monitoring connected cards. The case has been closed as fraud.
